items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: I had an artist draw out like it was the Golden Gate Bridge and had the Frisco name and the picture of the bridge

ctx.x: Where did you record the records?

I recorded right in-- I thought of this--I said I wanted the idea to be national, and I had an artist draw out like it was the Golden Gate Bridge and had the Frisco name and the picture of the bridge and I did that and did several numbers on there and it did very well.
